title: Stage selected UNC library promotion paths
summary: Stages a folder returned by the backend-owned Windows picker into its Library Profile field even when immediate path validation reports a warning.
reason: UNC promotion destinations could be selected successfully but remain blank when the backend could not immediately confirm the network folder.
behavior_before: The WebView discarded a non-canceled selected_path whenever the overall picker result was not ok, including validation-warning results for UNC folders.
behavior_after: The WebView stages every non-canceled selected_path returned by the trusted picker and displays any validation warning; settings preview/save validation remains authoritative.
rollback_plan: Restore the result.ok writeback gate in pathPicker.js.
notes:
Stage a trusted Windows picker result even when immediate UNC validation warns.
Refresh generated summary for the picker writeback change.
No media mutation or settings save occurs during picker staging; real-media validation is not required for this WebView-only fix.
